newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - POLISH 3-MONTH WIBOR SEEN AT 21.14 END-96.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - POLISH 3-MONTH WIBOR SEEN AT 21.14 END-96.

text.p: The Warsaw Interbank Offered Rate (WIBOR) for three-month deposits is expected to ease to 21.14 percent by the end of the year from 22.61 percent on Tuesday, a Reuter poll of Poland's 25 biggest banks showed.
The prediction is a mean average of banks' forecasts ranging from 18.50 percent to 25.02 percent. Last month, banks saw the rate at 19.18 percent on average at the end of 1996.
